llm_response.reason: The URL uses a deceptive subdomain trick by embedding a seemingly legitimate name ('BridgeDefiHub') before a less-known, recently registered domain ('globalpngonline.com'). Such a structure is common in scam sites, especially those attempting to exploit interest in decentralized finance and cryptocurrency investments. WHOIS data further supports this by showing the domain’s recent creation and use of a low-tier registrar.
